name.description: Name of the plugin; must match its folder under plugins/

namespace.description: Namespace of the types the plugin offers, e.g. iban for iban.validate; not one of Runnel's own (core, file, http, …)

executable.description: Program of the plugin, relative to its folder (e.g. bin/iban.exe), a command of the computer (e.g. python), or a mapping by operating system: windows, linux, darwin

args.description: Arguments of the program, e.g. [main.py] for a script; files in the folder of the plugin are relative to it
